intro: Resource slugs provide a predictable identifier from a display name. Collapsing separators prevents cosmetic differences in punctuation from generating awkward runs of hyphens.
task: Normalize ASCII names into lower-case hyphenated slugs and reject names with no letters or digits.
requirements: Require a string containing only ASCII characters. Lowercase it, replace each maximal run outside a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen, then trim outer hyphens. Return the slug; reject a result with no alphanumeric character.
Text inputs contain valid Unicode scalar characters and at most 10000 characters.
Return the documented Python output types and preserve all caller inputs. Raise ValueError for invalid inputs unless the task explicitly reports a record-level rejection.

hints.title: Trace one record
hints.body: Replace runs of separators, not each separator individually.

hints.title: Handle the boundary
hints.body: Validate that something remains after trimming outer hyphens.

explanation: Resource slugs provide a predictable identifier from a display name. Collapsing separators prevents cosmetic differences in punctuation from generating awkward runs of hyphens.
ASCII-only input avoids silently transliterating names with an unspecified policy. Slugs are not guaranteed unique, so a real registry must handle collisions separately.
